# Tool Design as API Design {#sec-tool-design}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- write tool schemas that a model uses correctly on the first try;
- design error messages that a model can recover from;
- keep a large tool surface usable through search and progressive disclosure;
- evaluate a tool by whether the model actually calls it right.

## Exercises

1. Take a tool with a 20%+ misuse rate. Rewrite only its description and enum values. Measure the change.
2. Write the three worst error messages a tool could return, then rewrite each so a model can recover.
